title: The Black Lodge
description: A small mod adding two decorative blocks based on Twin Peaks' Black Lodge and a music disc to fit the atmosphere.
body:
**The Black Lodge** adds two new decorative blocks based on the titular location from the TV show _Twin Peaks_, as well as a music disc to fit the athmosphere.
_(Warning: Made with MCreator)_


**Features**:

**- Lodge Tiles:**

![Black and white Lodge Tiles laied out in 4 different directions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a658209f4971b151ea4fa2ed1ccf027e83e4265.png)
  
**- Lodge Curtains:**

![A corner of a wall made with red Lodge Tiles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fddded8537828be91b744f00dabff7e9c446a702.png)
  
**- Music Disc:**

![A screenshot of the music disc tooltip as it appears in-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49983a27710888cb7923775908c6fec34439fe22.png)
